name: Sweet Spirit Foods
old_description: Since 2002, the cornerstone of our business has been our relationship with our customers. We understand that you have options when it comes to Gourmet Food Store businesses, so we do everything possible to make you feel like family. We promise to provide you with the best products for the best price, and to do everything we can to remain your supplier of choice for your  barbecue sauce and so much more!
about:
Sweet Spirit Foods was founded in July 2002 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, by the late Dr. Jayel Jacobs Jr., pastor and CEO of Christian Life Missionary Baptist Church, and his wife, Administrative Director Mrs. Joyce M. Jacobs. The venture began as a Snowie snow‑cone stand at 4621 NE 23rd Street and expanded to mobile food trucks, a restaurant in Langston, multiple Snowie buildings, a convenience store and a car wash in Coyle, all staffed by church volunteers.

The company produces a line of gourmet foods centered on barbecue sauces (mild, medium, hot) and a variety of preserves, jams, jellies, salsas, pickled vegetables and marinated items. Recipes were developed by blending family secrets from church members, and production is coordinated with a co‑packing facility and the agricultural department at Oklahoma State University. The operation remains volunteer‑run, with no disclosed facility size or headcount.

Sweet Spirit Foods sells through mass retailers including Walmart, Sam’s Club, Westlake Ace Hardware and Mardels, as well as at craft fairs, home‑and‑garden shows, conventions, the Oklahoma City and Tulsa State Fairs, and via door‑to‑door sales. A curbside‑pickup and local‑delivery service called Sweet Drop serves the Oklahoma City metro area.

The founders frame the business as a ministry outreach; the late Dr. Jacobs described the sauce as “given us by the Lord,” and the company emphasizes customer relationships over volume, promising “the best products for the best price” and treating buyers “like family.”
